title: Projects
text:
Before entering SIT, I studied Accountancy and Finance at Temasek Polytechnic. As part of my learning experience, I worked on a project related to personal finance tracking and budget analysis.
The project focused on recording daily expenses, categorising spending such as food, transport, and entertainment, and analysing spending patterns over time. The goal was to improve financial awareness and support better budgeting decisions.
Through this project, I gained a better understanding of how financial data can be organised and analysed to support decision-making. This experience also helped prepare me for learning new digital and analytical tools at SIT.

title: Reflection on the use of GenAI
text:
In this assessment, I used Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT to help me understand the tasks and instructions more clearly.
I chose this tool because it provides simple explanations and step-by-step guidance, which was useful when working with unfamiliar tools like Quarto. It helped me organise my content and complete the assessment more efficiently.
Overall, GenAI was beneficial in reducing confusion and improving my learning experience. In the future, I believe such tools can continue to support my studies by assisting with learning and problem-solving, while still requiring my own understanding and effort.
